GL_terminal_policy.classification: A canonical effective all-BACKBONE path ending with REACHED_GL_ACCOUNTING_CONSEQUENCE is COMPLETE_BACKBONE_ACCOUNTING_PATH.

atomic_path_admission.mandatory_set_preflight: Before optional admission, compute the distinct union of exact roots and required ANCHOR_OWNER_BRIDGE owner records. If that union exceeds 40, fail before emitting a partial selection.
atomic_path_admission.membership_reconsideration: A rejected path is never reconsidered for membership even if later admissions reduce its recomputed cost to zero. All of its provenance remains available through record-level all-supporting-path aggregation.
atomic_path_admission.policy: Admit a canonical path only as a whole. Add every currently unselected record in path order, or add none. A nonfitting path is skipped deterministically; later paths remain eligible in frozen order.
atomic_path_admission.zero_cost_behavior: Admit the path as provenance-supporting without consuming a record slot.

context_policy.anchor_context_owner_exit: A depth-1 CONTEXT path from an APPROVAL_EVENT or AUDIT_EVENT root to its exact operational owner is ANCHOR_OWNER_BRIDGE and mandatory before ordinary paths.
context_policy.locality: Only context records already present on frozen candidate paths are eligible.
context_policy.terminal_context_priority: LOCAL_TERMINAL_CONTEXT_PATH is considered after all backbone and supporting tiers.

exact_multi_policy.merge_policy: Select all roots first in ascending canonical record_id order. Merge all root paths into one global semantic ordering; never exhaust one root as a separate phase.
exact_multi_policy.root_tie_break_position: after semantic, terminal/completeness, transition-class, depth, and transition-sequence keys; before edge/path final fallbacks

forbidden_selection_signals: RCA label, failure class, expected answer, or case-specific rule
record text, actor name, status interpretation, or suspiciousness
learned score or numeric relevance weight
validation frequency or observed retrieval contribution
filesystem order, insertion order, randomness, or concurrency order
Payment-Bank heuristic, BankStatement membership, GL_JOURNAL, Tier B, or semantic fallback

allowed_selector_projection: transition IDs, relation IDs, directions, and frozen transition classes
depth, terminal status, and frozen stop reason
candidate minimum reachable depth and supporting path IDs
forbidden_fields_are_not_projected_into_: embedding, semantic, model, or LLM scores

multi_root_path_policy.fairness_basis: global semantic ordering before root/path fallback

parent_ranking_lineage_disposition.graph_v1_1_refinement: This preregistration expressly supersedes v1's generic direct-before-multihop and fewer-hops-first ordering for Graph v1.1 selection.
parent_ranking_lineage_disposition.reason: Typed v1.1 semantics distinguish complete/maximal backbone lifecycles, supporting projections, and terminal context; depth is subordinate to those frozen semantic roles.
parent_ranking_lineage_disposition.unchanged_controls: Exact anchors remain first, audit/event context remains below core deterministic lifecycle evidence, the 40-record maximum remains, and learned/weighted ranking remains prohibited.

preselection_semantic_families.BACKBONE_FAMILY: After removing one leading ANCHOR_OWNER_BRIDGE for classification only, every transition class is BACKBONE.
preselection_semantic_families.SUPPORTING_FAMILY: After removing one leading ANCHOR_OWNER_BRIDGE for classification only, classes are BACKBONE/SUPPORTING and at least one is SUPPORTING.
preselection_semantic_families.TERMINAL_CONTEXT_FAMILY: The final transition class is TERMINAL_CONTEXT and the path stops as TERMINAL_CONTEXT_REACHED.

path_canonicalization_policy.strict_prefix_definition: Within the same case and exact root, P is a strict prefix of Q only when P's record, transition, relation-direction, and edge sequences are all proper prefixes of Q's corresponding sequences.
path_canonicalization_policy.suppressed_prefix_resurrection: Never resurrect a REDUNDANT_PREFIX when its maximal same-family extension later fails atomic admission; provenance remains retained but membership order is not rerun.
path_canonicalization_policy.suppression_rule: Suppress P from budget competition as REDUNDANT_PREFIX only when P is a strict prefix of at least one longer candidate path Q in the same preselection semantic family, P is not terminal for an independently meaningful frozen reason, and P is not ANCHOR_OWNER_BRIDGE. A backbone or supporting prefix is never suppressed solely because it extends to a lower-priority terminal-context family.
path_canonicalization_policy.tie_for_multiple_extensions: Record every canonical extending path_id in the redundant-prefix ledger; extension choice does not affect suppression.

path_classification_algorithm: Classify an exact depth-1 CONTEXT owner exit from an APPROVAL_EVENT or AUDIT_EVENT root as TIER_1 ANCHOR_OWNER_BRIDGE.
For a longer path beginning with that bridge, remove only the leading CONTEXT class for classification; retain the complete path and provenance for admission.
If the final class is TERMINAL_CONTEXT and stop reason is TERMINAL_CONTEXT_REACHED, classify TIER_5 LOCAL_TERMINAL_CONTEXT_PATH before considering the normalized suffix classes.
Else if normalized classes are all BACKBONE and the final frozen transition rule is STOP_AFTER_ACCOUNTING_CONSEQUENCE with GL_ENTRY endpoint, classify TIER_2 COMPLETE_BACKBONE_ACCOUNTING_PATH.
Else if normalized classes are all BACKBONE and the path is canonical-maximal within BACKBONE_FAMILY, classify TIER_3 MAXIMAL_BACKBONE_LIFECYCLE_PATH.
Else if normalized classes are only BACKBONE/SUPPORTING and contain SUPPORTING, classify TIER_4 BACKBONE_PLUS_SUPPORTING_PATH, including SUPPORTING-only direct projections.
Otherwise fail structural validation as UNHANDLED_FROZEN_PATH_CLASS_COMBINATION; no implicit context bucket is created.
path_new_record_cost_definition: Count distinct record_ids on the candidate path that are not already globally selected for the case. Mandatory anchors and all shared selected records cost zero.

path_priority_tiers.semantics: Every exact resolved root; records are selected before paths.
The exact depth-1 CONTEXT owner exit when an APPROVAL_EVENT or AUDIT_EVENT is itself the root.
After removing one leading ANCHOR_OWNER_BRIDGE class for classification only, every transition is BACKBONE and the path ends at frozen REACHED_GL_ACCOUNTING_CONSEQUENCE.
After removing one leading ANCHOR_OWNER_BRIDGE class for classification only, every transition is BACKBONE and the canonical path is maximal within BACKBONE_FAMILY under prefix canonicalization.
After removing one leading ANCHOR_OWNER_BRIDGE class for classification only, transition classes are a nonempty subset of BACKBONE/SUPPORTING containing SUPPORTING.
A frozen candidate path whose final transition class is TERMINAL_CONTEXT and stop reason is TERMINAL_CONTEXT_REACHED.

selected_record_order_policy.anchor_order: all mandatory roots first by ascending canonical record_id

fail_closed_conditions: selected record absent from candidate pool

terminal_state_policy.MAX_DEPTH_REACHED: independently meaningful frozen stop and not prefix-suppressed
